reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-08: Neutrl Accountable dashboard type_split snapshot (total reserves $56,860,690.76, supply $54,789,136.33, collateralization 103.78%) exposes six named reserve buckets. Curated slice names mirror the adapter renameMap verbatim. Weights refreshed to the 2026-08-08 capture: Stablecoin 56.28%, JLP 17.29%, OTC Aggregate 17.35%, Other 5.52%, Protocol Owned Liquidity 3.55%, ETH 0.01%. The stablecoin bucket remains an aggregate; the stablecoin_split API sub-buckets (USDe, USDT, USDC, sUSDS) are not used as primary slices because the configured adapter bucket is type_split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable type_split categories and weights captured 2026-08-08 from the issuer's live reserve API
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Stablecoin constituents, OTC counterparties, JLP underlying positions, and the composition and custody of the Other and Protocol Owned Liquidity categories are not disclosed in the reviewed snapshot.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: No constituent weights are available for a canonical dependency mapping.
The dashboard names the JLP category but does not expose the current underlying position or custody detail needed for a tracked dependency.
The dashboard reports an aggregate OTC category without identifying current counterparties, contracts, or settlement terms.
The dashboard does not disclose the asset classes or providers included in the Other category.
The dashboard names protocol-owned liquidity but does not expose pool identities, underlying assets, or custody details.
The residual ETH bucket is external cryptoasset collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
